title: Built-in Python for Android
summary: Prepare version 1.0.6 with a real CPython interpreter running directly on the phone, offline code execution, and AI Teacher help.

changes.detail: Embedded CPython 3.14 through Chaquopy, running in a disposable Android process with Stop and a ten-second timeout.
Offline code editor, pre-entered input() answers, real output/errors and AI Teacher explanation of code/results.
Android lab now uses on-device Python instead of the PC API. Version bumped to 1.0.6/code 8 to isolate native runtime compatibility.
